First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Springbike Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A north side road ride from the Bill and Payne Stewart Golf Course. The route is 23 miles with about 800 feet of climbing and a rest stop in Strafford. The club also runs Monday and Wednesday night rides from Rogersville and Republic. The club's insurance requires riders to be members. The schedule on the club site was posted for 2025.
